text_zh: 自熔蜡中重铸，其形不灭——纵炉火吞噬，铅字仍自坠落中复起。唯献此器于引擎，方得更深试炼。
text_en: Recast from molten wax, its form endures—though fire consumes, the leaden word rises from its fall. Only in offering does deeper trial await.

text_zh:
汝若倾覆，烬中必得重铸。

圣徒遗物 · 不死鸟
Object Class: Apollyon
出土地点: 第XI层 炉膛深处
描述: 金属鸟形器物，翼展███cm。于收容震颤导致站点污染时自燃，随即重构收容时序。消耗品D-████报告"时间倒转"感知，经核实为正常效应。
附加效应: 第V层执事试炼与第XII层引擎核心期间，残余异文生成频率显著提升。
备注: 每次激活后遗物自毁。已记录激活███次，每次后发现同规格替代品。来源不明。
text_en:
Should thy work collapse, from ashes shall it rise anew.
────
Sacred Artifact · Phoenix
Object Class: Apollyon
Recovery Site: Layer XI, Deep Furnace Chamber
Description: Metallic avian construct, wingspan ███cm. Self-immolates upon containment breach scenarios, subsequently reconstituting temporal sequence. Subject D-████ reported "time reversal" sensation, verified as standard effect.
Secondary Effects: During Layer V Deacon's Trial and Layer XII Engine Core phases, residual anomaly manifestation rate increases substantially.
Note: Artifact self-destructs upon each activation. ███ activations logged, identical replacement found after each occurrence. Origin unknown.
